title: State income, property and sales tax rates, and median home values

states.description: The first entry is the national row. The site uses it as the default.

name.description: Plain name. The Zillow updater matches on this.

selectLabel.description: Optional override for the text in the state picker.

propertyTaxRatePct.description: Yearly property tax as a percentage of home value. Owed every year, on a home owned outright.

salesTaxRatePct.description: State rate plus the average local rate, the source's combined column. Alaska levies no state sales tax but its boroughs do, so it is 1.82%, not zero. Only Delaware, Montana, New Hampshire and Oregon are genuinely zero.
